tagline: Hijab and modest-wear production from South Tangerang.

story.title: Hijab and modest-wear production from South Tangerang.
story.body: Haira menghadirkan koleksi busana muslim dan hijab modis berkualitas yang memadukan keanggunan desain kontemporer dengan kenyamanan material lembut untuk gaya harian dan acara istimewa wanita modern.

highlights.title: Buyer discovery
highlights.body: A concise profile for retail, boutique, gifting and buyer introductions.

highlights.title: Desain Modest Elegan
highlights.body: Potongan busana muslim yang anggun dengan siluet feminin yang nyaman dan santun.

highlights.title: Kanal Komunikasi Langsung
highlights.body: Layanan konsultasi gaya dan pemesanan busana melalui kanal Instagram resmi @hafra__id.

highlights.title: NFC ready
highlights.body: Mobile-first layout with large tap targets for exhibition use.

verification.note: Public search found multiple Rizka Fauziah identities, including unrelated businesses. None was strong enough to safely bind to the TEI fashion tenant Haira, so the profile remains handover-verified.
